svg.text: match a wire’s number on the drawing · ● = wires joined
One leg of 240-volt power to the contactor.
Compressor run terminal to capacitor common.
Compressor start winding to run capacitor.
Run capacitor fan terminal to outdoor fan motor.
Outdoor fan motor return to capacitor common.

Time-delay board output to liquid-line solenoid.
“C” = Common everywhere — but a different wire each place.
